Noelle (People Ops): Hey all — following up from the all-hands Q&A thread. Drop any extra questions about mid-year promotions, leveling transparency, comp bands, or benefits here. Well publish a short FAQ + timeline by Tuesday.

Hannah (SWE): Two quick ones: 1) Can managers share a reason for "denied" promo to the IC? 2) Will calibration notes be visible to nominees?

Noelle (People Ops): 1) Managers should provide a clear development-oriented note to the IC after calibration; we encourage coaching language and specific next steps. 2) Calibration deliberations remain internal, but managers will receive a summary rationale to share with the IC. We do not publish raw ballots.

Liam (Manager): For transparency, can we get an anonymized distribution of promotions by level/team so we can spot skew?

Diego (Comp): Yes, well include anonymized histograms by level and function in the post-cycle report. Itll show promotion rates and median comp moves (no names). Expect that in the mid-year package.

Wei (RE-SWE): Question re: equity cliff/vesting on promotions — if someone gets promoted and also receives a refresh grant, does vesting reset?

Diego (Comp): Promo grants are usually additional awards with their own vesting schedule. They do not retroactively reset existing grants. Comp will include examples in the FAQ showing typical vesting timelines for promo grants vs refresh grants.

Hannah (SWE): Remote relocation: if someone moves countries mid-cycle and gets a market adjustment, how is that handled?

Noelle (People Ops): Relocations are evaluated case-by-case. We have a relocation policy that may trigger a location-based comp update; if move is effective before the cut-off, we consider local banding for that payroll period. Managers should flag relocations early.

Liam (Manager): Appeals — do we allow manager-initiated re-reviews or only employee-initiated?

Noelle (People Ops): Appeals must be submitted by managers on behalf of employees. We handle requests for re-review if theres material new evidence. People Ops + calibration chair triage and may convene an expedited panel.

payroll-bot: FYI: mid-year payroll cut-off = 2026-06-22. Any comp changes confirmed after that will post in the August payroll run.

Wei (RE-SWE): Will there be a required template for manager notes to ensure fairness?

Noelle (People Ops): Yes — were rolling out a short signal-first template (3 signals + 1-line impact + links). Itll be mandatory for calibration to streamline comparisons. Template link will be in the FAQ.

Hannah (SWE): Last one — parental/family leave: confirm that time on leave doesnt reduce promo eligibility windows?

Diego (Comp): Confirmed — paid parental and medical leave are excluded from negative calibration adjustments. Managers should annotate leave in the packet so calibrators are aware.

Noelle (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Action items: managers — use the new short template, note relocations/leave, attach links, and keep appeal evidence ready. Well post the FAQ, anonymized promotion distributions, and the mandatory template in #announcements by Tuesday EOD. :sparkles:
